name: Reconcile mail relay
description: Keeps a hardened ingest relay in step with this deployment: pushes the alias routing map, pulls the sealed mail spool, advances relay cloud provisioning, and reconciles the hosted relay fleet — in that order, every cron pass. No-op on colocated deployments.

force_map_push.label: Force an alias-map re-push even when unchanged (e.g. after a relay rebuild)
